           AVG(CASE 
               WHEN LOWER(sd."ENVsense") = 'low' THEN 1
               WHEN LOWER(sd."ENVsense") = 'medium' THEN 5
               WHEN LOWER(sd."ENVsense") = 'high' THEN 10
               ELSE 5
           END) as erf
    FROM "SensitivityData" sd
    WHERE sd."ART_link" IN (SELECT "ARTregID" FROM "ArtifactsCore" WHERE "MatKind" = 'Textile')

)

FROM textile_env te
